decisions.reason: After several years of investment in a core second-channel security capability that fits the firm's cross-channel identity strategy, management is likely to treat any weaker uptake as temporary and continue backing it.

The mobile PDF signature function remains closely aligned with the firm's public move toward app-based interactions and online signing, so accumulated investment and commitment make withdrawal unlikely.
Although more specialized, it still supports the firm's secure messaging ecosystem and management can justify uneven demand as a gradual enterprise adoption issue rather than a reason to exit now.
The compliance suite draws on the firm's regulatory-security expertise and, in a growing market, management is inclined to persist with it rather than reverse a visible multi-year commitment.
